pages.title: Don't Ask, It's Protein
pages.text: Baked Maggots are processed from maggots and can be obtained while building a fly farm.$(br2)Roundworms drop from poop leaves and can be eaten, but they are more often cooked into string.
If you are brave, you can try raw maggots or roundworms.$(br2)However, cooking them first is usually the wiser choice.
